name: How long does a bathroom shower removal project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom shower removal project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing an existing shower stall or tiled enclosure typically takes one to two days for demolition, debris removal, and initial framing inspection. The full timeline expands if you uncover hidden water damage or decide to move drain and supply lines. When replacing the unit with custom tile, moisture-resistant drywall, or an accessible walk-in design, the entire project timeline depends on the subsequent plumbing, framing, and finish steps. As an owner-operated team, we supervise demolition directly to ensure the surrounding bathroom remains protected and clean throughout the tear-out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shower demolition and cleanup usually take one to two days. Overall project timing extends if underlying rot repairs, plumbing line moves, or custom tile installations follow.
